ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: The query is a short, conversational explanatory request delivered in a warm, friendly tone. Both models score essentially tied on the relevant capability dimensions (Creative Generation and Support Dialogue differences are within variance), so I used self-reported task preferences as a tiebreaker: Lapwing reports a strong appetite for open-ended generative work and the friendly tone aligns with it, while Plover reports an aversion to open-ended generative work. Routing to the model that prefers this kind of task — with no expected quality cost — is the sensible default.
